from ledgerly.adjustments import issue_credit_note

    return Invoice("inv_x","cus",lines=[LineItem("x",1,Decimal(total))],status="issued")

a=issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("10.00"), "r", idempotency_key="k")
b=issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("10.00"), "r", idempotency_key="k")
print(a==b, len(audit.events("credit_note_issued")))
EOF"}
